Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter and Zaiqa Kitchen apps, version 2.15.7.

KOT now prints the price of open-price items
- Items without a fixed price (like Fish) now show the price the waiter or admin entered on the kitchen slip, e.g. "1 x Fish - Rs 650" (with the line total when quantity is more than one).
- Works for new, extra and reprinted KOTs, from the admin and from waiters.
